what: Label-free inflation guard for the agreement + escalation rule (Ours_Inflation_Guard.ipynb), now with a dead zone.
rule: per photo: level = running mean (weight 30, started at the prior) of the mean inliers of the candidates more than 4 sigma from the choice (train.checks.scale_robust.far_levels / running_level); ratio = level / prior; factor = ratio if ratio > 1.5 else 1.0; bar 8, escalation bar 11 and the agreement per-query floor 3 are each multiplied by factor and rounded.
prior: 0.157 = the larger of the far levels of official150 (0.030) and nudt707 (0.157), measured before the new draw; official stays below it so it is never scaled
dead_zone_reason: between-set spread of NUDT wrong-place levels is about 1.3x (his T10 priors 0.185 PC / 0.237 Jetson); a guard must stay silent inside that spread. 1.5 chosen from that spread and written before the new draw was read; not tuned on nudt1010 (clean cost -0.72 there with no dead zone).
test_set: NUDT VALID split (other flights than the test split used by every earlier draw), seed 1212, 150 photos, dumped with the unchanged rich-dump pipeline (27 queries) before any rule is scored
stress: every inlier count x 1, 1.25, 1.5, 2 for ours with and without the guard
adopt_if: x1: wrong answers not higher than unguarded and score difference >= -0.30 (paired)
x2: wrong answers lower than unguarded
x1.5: wrong answers not higher than unguarded
otherwise: not adopted; written up as a negative or inconclusive result
no_labels: nothing in the guard uses truth; only inlier counts and candidate positions
